findings.evidence: Lines 123–125 make the claim immediately before defining `matrixCoeffLpₛₗ : V →ₗ⋆[𝕜] V →ₗ[𝕜] Lp ...`; `rg -n "isotypic|matrixCoeffLp"` finds no supporting isotypic-block declaration in this compact representation development.
findings.fix: Remove the claim, or restate it precisely in terms of the span of all values `matrixCoeffLpₛₗ π hπ v w` with the hypotheses under which the Peter–Weyl identification holds.
findings.issue: The `matrixCoeffLpₛₗ` docstring says “the map whose range spans the `π`-isotypic block of `L²(G)`,” but its outer range consists of linear maps `V →ₗ Lp`, not elements of `L²`; moreover no irreducibility, finite-dimensionality, or definition of this isotypic block is present.

findings.evidence: The theorem begins directly at line 143 after a section comment; the module’s “Main statements” list identifies it at lines 40–41 as a principal result.
findings.fix: Add a docstring explaining that the `L²` coefficient is zero exactly when the original continuous matrix coefficient is identically zero.
findings.issue: `matrixCoeffLp_eq_zero_iff` is listed as a main statement in the module docstring but has no declaration docstring.

summary: A main theorem lacks declaration documentation, and the bundled-map docstring makes an unsupported and type-misleading isotypic-block claim.
